args.section_json:
{
  "conventions": [
    "TypeScript 5.9 strict mode with ESM; format with Prettier (double quotes, semicolons, trailing commas, 80-column print width) and pass ESLint with --max-warnings=0.",
    "Group imports with a blank line between groups in ESLint import/order sequence: external packages first, then @excalidraw/* workspace packages, then parent/sibling relative imports, and separate-type-imports (import type) last.",
    "Export shared utilities from packages/common/src/colors.ts as typed arrow functions (export const fn = ...), which are re-exported from @excalidraw/common via export * from './colors' in packages/common/src/index.ts.",
    "Vitest tests use globals (bare describe, it, expect, vi) under jsdom with vitest-canvas-mock; editor integration tests in packages/excalidraw/tests/*.test.tsx render <Excalidraw /> via ./test-utils and drive interactions with API, Keyboard, Pointer, and fireEvent."
  ],
  "decisions": [
    {
      "topic": "Uncached forward dark-mode helper and invertDarkModeFilter algorithm",
      "choice": "Extract an unexported applyDarkModeFilterToRgb(r, g, b) helper in packages/common/src/colors.ts that runs cssInvert(r, g, b, 93) followed by cssHueRotate(..., 180 as Degrees), and use it in both applyDarkModeFilter and invertDarkModeFilter; invertDarkModeFilter parses the color with tinycolor, computes the analytic inverse (cssHueRotate by 180 degrees followed by the per-channel inverse of 93% cssInvert: Math.round(clamp((c - 255 * 0.93) / (1 - 2 * 0.93), 0, 255))), keeps that initial estimate if applyDarkModeFilterToRgb already matches the target RGB, else searches offsets in [-3, 3] per channel for a match, and returns rgbToHex(..., alpha) without reading or writing DARK_MODE_COLORS_CACHE.",
      "rejected": [
        "Special-casing #000000, #ffffff, or #1e1e1e in a lookup table",
        "Calling the cached applyDarkModeFilter inside the refinement loop"
      ],
      "reason": "A single general inverse with [-3, 3] neighbour

args.name: units-001.json
args.section_json:
[
  {
    "id": "U01",
    "path": "packages/common/src/colors.test.ts",
    "action": "edit",
    "phase": "tests",
    "behaviour": "Add unit tests for invertDarkModeFilter covering sampled RGB grid redraw round-trip, exact hex recovery for #1e1e1e/#000000/#ffffff, alpha preservation, unreachable pixels, and leaving DARK_MODE_COLORS_CACHE untouched.",
    "rules": [
      "1. Import invertDarkModeFilter alongside applyDarkModeFilter, COLOR_PALETTE, and rgbToHex from @excalidraw/common.",
      "2. Add a describe('invertDarkModeFilter', ...) block after the describe('applyDarkModeFilter', ...) block.",
      "3. In the grid round-trip test, sample r, g, b from 0 to 255 in steps of 17 (4,096 colours so the test finishes well under 1 second), compute p = applyDarkModeFilter(rgbToHex(r, g, b)), and assert applyDarkModeFilter(invertDarkModeFilter(p)) === p.",
      "4. Assert exact hex recovery invertDarkModeFilter(applyDarkModeFilter(c)) === c for #1e1e1e, #000000, and #ffffff.",
      "5. Assert alpha preservation on #rrggbbaa inputs (such as applyDarkModeFilter('#1e1e1e80') returning '#1e1e1e80' and '#ff909000' keeping the '00' alpha suffix).",
      "6. For unreachable pixels ('#ffffff', '#000000', '#0000ff'), assert invertDarkModeFilter returns a valid 6-digit hex string matching /^#[0-9a-f]{6}$/ without throwing.",
      "7. For the cache spy test, compute const reachable = applyDarkModeFilter('#1e1e1e') before installing const setSpy = vi.spyOn(Map.prototype, 'set'), call invertDarkModeFilter('#0000ff') and invertDarkModeFilter(reachable) inside a try/finally that calls setSpy.mockRestore(), and assert expect(setSpy).not.toHaveBeenCalled()."
    ],
    "exports": [],
    "import_line": "",
    "sites": [
      {
        "id": "S1",
        "at": "replace",
        "from": 1,
        "to": 5,
        "first_line": "import {",
        "last_line": "} from \"@excalidraw/common\";",
        "rule": "Import invertDarkModeFilter alongside applyDarkModeFilter, COLOR_PA
